findings.title: The Enemy Within. Tracking LIMINAL PANDA and SilentAir through Mobile Networks
findings.summary_md: Enea disclosed SilentAir, a previously unknown state-level actor that runs SS7 and Diameter signaling attacks from hijacked network nodes inside mobile operators in at least six Asian countries, with Taiwan as the primary target. The report also tracks LIMINAL PANDA activity through 2026 and notes SilentAir has been active since before 2025, with a dozen other countries and territories affected. Enea assessed with low confidence that SilentAir aligns with China-nexus operations based on the Taiwan focus, absence of Chinese targets, and UTC+8 working-day timing.

findings.title: Hacked Asian Telcos Used to Intercept Taiwanese Calls and Texts
findings.summary_md: Infosecurity Magazine reported Enea's findings on SilentAir, including interception of 2FA codes for some targets and silent SMS activity directed largely at Taiwanese users around midnight. The article notes Enea has monitored the actor since early 2025 and that attacks came in waves ranging from a handful to several thousand subscribers in a month. It also records that CrowdStrike linked LIMINAL PANDA to China-nexus operations in November 2024.

findings.title: Unveiling LIMINAL PANDA - Threats to Telecom Sector
findings.summary_md: CrowdStrike publicly disclosed LIMINAL PANDA, a China-nexus actor targeting telecommunications providers since at least 2020, ahead of Adam Meyers' November 19, 2024 testimony to the U.S. Senate Judiciary Subcommittee. The group uses compromised telecom servers to reach further providers, emulates GSM protocols for command and control, and retrieves subscriber information, call metadata, and SMS. Enea later observed overlapping SilentAir and LIMINAL PANDA activity at some of the same operators, though it could not confirm a link.
